title: With Barshalūna already under siege, a Mamlūk army of 4,272 under another cousin of the Baḥrī house marches through Girona for Castelló d'Empúries, in the far north of Catalonia under the Pyrenees: the ally keeps its word, and the Aiman faction at court gains by it

army.name: Jaysh 1
army.supply: cannot draw food in Girona, beyond its logistics range (41.2)

data.commander: a cousin of the Baḥrī house (Baḥriyya), as Aiman and the shaykh of Barqa are

source: Trent's account and screenshot of 6 January 1375

title: The court divides along the sultan's two marriages. Duʿā's family, the Marīnids of Fās, twice made war on the Emirate; Aiman's, the Baḥrī Mamlūks, fight beside it in Sicily, Malta and Catalonia. The Mamlūk commitment is a boon for the Aiman faction

data.aimanFaction: the Mamlūk alliance, Aiman and her son Yūsuf
data.duaFaction: Duʿā, the heir Ismāʿīl, the regency at Gharnāṭa
